newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Commonwealth officials to visit Nigeria Monday.
newsitem.headline: Commonwealth officials to visit Nigeria Monday.

text.p: Commonwealth officials will arrive in the Nigerian capital on Monday for meetings with officials of the military government, Foreign Ministry officials said on Friday.
Commonwealth ministers, meeting in London last month, said they would send top officials to Nigeria in a bid to persuade the government to accept a mission investigating alleged human rights abuses.
"They should arrive on Monday and stay for two days. It is not yet entirely clear who they will meet," one senior Foreign Ministry official said.
Nigeria has said it would allow the officials to visit, but is adamant the only item on the agenda is the question of its suspension from the club of Britain and its former colonies.
The Commonwealth suspended Nigeria, Africa's most populous nation, in November, days after after it hanged nine minority rights activists for murder in the face of international appeals for clemency.
Nigeria said on Friday economic constraints had forced it to close its embassy in Canada, the most outspoken Commonwealth member in calling for action to be taken against Nigeria.
